_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'COST ESTIMATES' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.04.02.

f01_Activity_Identifier_and_Description.section: Activity and Work Package Cost Breakdown
f01_Activity_Identifier_and_Description.label: Activity Identifier and Description
f01_Activity_Identifier_and_Description.guidance: Unique activity code and concise work summary for each estimated item.

f02_Direct_Labor_Cost_Estimate.section: Activity and Work Package Cost Breakdown
f02_Direct_Labor_Cost_Estimate.label: Direct Labor Cost Estimate
f02_Direct_Labor_Cost_Estimate.guidance: Estimated direct staffing expenses calculated from effort hours and labor rates.

f03_Materials_and_Equipment_Cost_Estimat.section: Activity and Work Package Cost Breakdown
f03_Materials_and_Equipment_Cost_Estimat.label: Materials and Equipment Cost Estimate
f03_Materials_and_Equipment_Cost_Estimat.guidance: Estimated costs for hardware, raw materials, software licensing, and equipment.

f04_Total_Base_Cost_Estimate.section: Activity and Work Package Cost Breakdown
f04_Total_Base_Cost_Estimate.label: Total Base Cost Estimate
f04_Total_Base_Cost_Estimate.guidance: Consolidated base financial estimate prior to reserve calculations.

f05_Labor_Rate_Categories_and_Rate_Cards.label: Labor Rate Categories and Rate Cards
f05_Labor_Rate_Categories_and_Rate_Cards.guidance: Standard billing rate categories, consultant day-rates, and internal unit costs.

f06_Historical_Data_and_Estimating_Assum.section: Resource Cost Rates and Basis of Estimates
f06_Historical_Data_and_Estimating_Assum.label: Historical Data and Estimating Assumptions
f06_Historical_Data_and_Estimating_Assum.guidance: Benchmark data, vendor quotation references, and key assumptions applied.

f07_Contingency_Reserve_Allocation.label: Contingency Reserve Allocation
